details.label: Limitations and gaps
Task-specific test record

metrics.chance: about the sum of squared class shares (Cohen's chance term)
metrics.definition: Hidden genes called with their true label, divided by ALL hidden genes. A gene the strategy declined to call counts as wrong.
metrics.label: Accuracy, all eligible
metrics.reading: The headline for label calls. Counting abstentions as errors stops a strategy looking accurate by calling only the easy genes; coverage and precision of calls split it apart.

metrics.chance: not applicable (a property of the strategy, not of luck)
metrics.definition: Share of hidden genes that received any call.
metrics.label: Coverage
metrics.reading: How far the strategy reaches. A network strategy cannot call a gene with no edges; a low coverage with a high precision of calls is a precise but narrow tool.

metrics.chance: as accuracy, among the genes called
metrics.definition: Correct calls divided by calls made (also called selective accuracy).
metrics.label: Accuracy among calls
metrics.reading: How far to trust one call. Equals accuracy when coverage is 1.

metrics.definition: For each true class: of the genes called that class, the share that truly are; averaged over classes with equal weight. A class never called scores 0.
metrics.label: Macro precision
metrics.reading: Whether calls of the RARE classes can be trusted too; a strategy that only ever calls the commonest class scores low.

metrics.chance: 1 / number of classes, for a caller that ignores the data
metrics.definition: For each true class: the share of its hidden genes called correctly; averaged over classes with equal weight. Identical to balanced accuracy.
metrics.label: Macro recall (balanced accuracy)
metrics.reading: Whether every class is found, not just the large ones. Compare with accuracy: a large gap means the strategy lives on the big classes.

metrics.chance: low; roughly the average class share
metrics.definition: Per class, the harmonic mean of precision and recall; averaged over classes with equal weight.
metrics.label: Macro F1
metrics.reading: One number balancing finding each class and being right when calling it, with rare classes counted as much as common ones.

metrics.chance: about the sum of squared class shares
metrics.definition: Per-class F1 averaged with each class weighted by its number of hidden genes.
metrics.label: Weighted F1
metrics.reading: Macro F1's counterpart that follows the class sizes; close to accuracy when coverage is high.

metrics.definition: Agreement between calls and truth corrected for the agreement their class frequencies alone would give: (observed - expected) / (1 - expected). No call is its own category.
metrics.label: Cohen's kappa
metrics.reading: Accuracy with chance removed: 0 is no better than matching class frequencies, 1 is perfect. Comparable across labels with different numbers and sizes of classes.

metrics.definition: The multiclass Matthews correlation coefficient (Gorodkin's R_K) between calls and truth, with no call as its own category.
metrics.label: Matthews correlation (MCC)
metrics.reading: A correlation between the call and the truth that stays honest under strong class imbalance; often the single most informative number for an unbalanced label.

metrics.definition: For each class, the probability that a random hidden gene of that class gets a higher score for the class than a random hidden gene of another class; averaged over classes. Needs per-class scores.
metrics.label: Macro AUROC
metrics.reading: How well the strategy's scores separate each class from the rest, before any threshold is chosen. Missing for strategies that call labels without scoring every class.

metrics.chance: the class's share among hidden genes, averaged
metrics.definition: For each class, the area under the precision-recall curve of its one-vs-rest scores (average precision); averaged over classes. Needs per-class scores.
metrics.label: Macro AUPRC
metrics.reading: Like macro AUROC but dominated by the top of each ranking, which is where calls are made; far below AUROC means good separation overall but a noisy top.

metrics.definition: Eligible rows with no labels in their prediction set, divided by all eligible rows.
metrics.label: Empty-set share
metrics.reading: Empty sets are abstentions and coverage misses. Their native efficiency contribution is nevertheless the same as a singleton; inspect both measures.

metrics.definition: Mean number of distinct labels in each prediction set over all eligible rows, including empty sets.
metrics.label: Mean prediction-set size
metrics.range: 0 to the number of declared model classes
metrics.reading: Smaller sets narrow the answer only when coverage remains adequate. A set containing every model class provides little resolution.

metrics.chance: not applicable; a setting rather than achieved coverage
metrics.definition: Declared one minus conformal alpha, fixed before the final label test.
metrics.label: Nominal prediction-set coverage
metrics.reading: Compare with achieved prediction-set coverage and size. Source/context/exchangeability review is required; this setting is not a per-gene correctness probability.

metrics.chance: depends on set size and label distribution; not a fixed chance rate
metrics.definition: Eligible rows whose prediction set contains their observed label, divided by all eligible rows. An empty set is uncovered.
metrics.label: Prediction-set coverage, all eligible
metrics.reading: Inspect coverage with set size, empty-set share and singleton-call coverage. Recovering source labels does not establish independent biological validity.

metrics.chance: measured by the same procedure on shuffled labels where a null is supplied
metrics.definition: For C declared model classes, 1 - (mean(clip(set size, 1, C)) - 1) / (C - 1). Unavailable when C is less than two, classes are unspecified or the cohort is empty.
metrics.label: Prediction-set efficiency
metrics.reading: One means singleton-sized or empty sets; zero means all-class sets. Empty sets are clipped to size one here but count as coverage misses. Inspect achieved coverage and empty-set share.

metrics.definition: Eligible rows with exactly one label in their prediction set, divided by all eligible rows.
metrics.label: Singleton-set share
metrics.reading: For recorded conformal label outcomes, only singleton sets produce individual label calls. This is reach, not correctness.
